PRINT AT 100% / ACTUAL SIZE — Do NOT “fit to page”
An X of lines around the
Fold it in half like a
A computer program waits for an INPUT: a key, a tap, a click. Then it gives an OUTPUT.
Your crow works the same way. Input: pull the sides apart. Output: the beak opens.
Input: push the sides together. Output: the beak shuts. It never gets it wrong!
• Hold one side in each hand, thumbs on the eyes. Pull apart a little, push back. Caw!
• Beak stuck? Open the crow flat and press the four beak creases (steps 6–9) again.
• The points must fold forward BETWEEN the sides, not behind them.
• Give your crow a voice: one caw = yes, two caws = no. That is a code!
• Plain paper? Draw an eye on each side and colour the beak yellow.
Measure: this bar must be exactly 100 mm. Print at 100%, not "fit to page".
